denver-colorado-rockies-million-dollar-h.slogan: Two passes and 694 km, high point 3350 m
denver-colorado-rockies-million-dollar-h.story: A proper escape from Denver with roads worth waking up for. Out of Castle Rock and back again: 694 km, roughly 14 h 28 in the saddle. It goes by way of Scenic stretch near Georgetown, near Estes Park and Fort Morgan. The climbs: near Woodland Park and Near Fort Morgan, on the way back. It tops out at about 3,350 m. The line favours views over speed.

places-cingle-de-l-ermita-abric-i-cabra-.story: A 246 km round trip from Albocàsser - roughly 4 h 14 in the saddle. It goes by way of Els figuerals, Cabra feixet and back through Els figuerals. The line favours views over speed.
